name: Handmade Wooden Elephant Toy
description: Artisanal wooden elephant toy hand-carved from sustainable Ivory wood and finished with non-toxic lacquer coloring. Traditional handicraft from Channapatna.

name: Handmade Wooden Car
description: Eco-friendly wooden toy car with rotating wheels. Hand-carved from soft wood, using natural dyes for vibrant colors.

name: Wooden Puzzle
description: Brain-teasing 3D wooden puzzle blocks made from high quality teak wood. Perfect educational toy for child development.

name: Terracotta Clay Pot
description: Traditional hand-molded clay pot, perfect for cooling water naturally or as a decorative garden planter. Made with organic Madurai clay.

name: Painted Clay Diya (Set of 10)
description: Hand-painted terracotta clay diyas with colorful patterns for festive decoration. Baked in traditional brick kilns.

name: Ceramic Flower Vase
description: Elegant hand-glazed ceramic flower vase in cobalt blue. Handcrafted by potters of Khurja using traditional ceramic firing techniques.

name: Handwoven Silk Sari
description: Exquisite hand-loomed Kanchipuram pure silk sari featuring rich golden zari borders and classic motif work. Represents days of manual weaving.

name: Handloom Cotton Kurta
description: Breathable hand-spun cotton men's kurta. Made from organic cotton dyed with natural vegetable colors.

name: Handmade Jute Bag
description: Durable and fashionable tote bag made from 100% natural, biodegradable jute fiber. Includes soft cotton handles and a zippered compartment.

name: Embroidered Leather Mojaris
description: Traditional handcrafted Rajasthani leather mojaris (shoes) adorned with colorful thread embroidery and mirror work. Premium camel leather.

name: Bamboo Hanging Lamp
description: Eco-friendly hanging pendant lamp shade handcrafted from thin strips of bamboo. Creates beautiful shadow patterns when lit. Includes holder.

name: Handmade Brass Buddha Statue
description: Elegant brass statue of Lord Buddha in a meditative pose. Hand-cast and polished by metal artisans of Moradabad using ancient lost-wax technique.
